fact: The Partnership Compact of January 2024 lists, among the actions the General Education Sector Plan 2023-2027 proposes, a system of unique learner and teacher identification numbers and school identifiers, integrated into the annual school census and consistent across data collection platforms such as SAMSS under the EMIS code; it is stated as a proposed action, not as something in place.
title: Partnership Compact
publisher: Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of General Education and Instruction
